security_audit.summary: Most flags reflect Markdown formatting, readable Chinese documentation, normal dictionary caching, and expected API configuration. Both HTTP helpers can forward quota credentials across host redirects or HTTPS downgrades, creating a conditional credential-disclosure risk. No evidence found of malicious intent, prompt injection, shell execution, or unrelated secret collection.

remediation.issue: Both HTTP helpers follow redirects while retaining the X-FS-Quota credential header.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and reject cross-origin or downgrade redirects for authenticated requests. Add redirect tests for both GET and POST without using real tokens.

content.user_title: Find Visual Styles From Mood Descriptions
content.value_statement: Vague mood descriptions can be difficult to translate into clear art direction. This skill matches descriptions to feeling words and visual-style candidates with definitions.
actual_capabilities: Match descriptions against a downloaded dictionary and rank associated visual styles locally.
Return style names, definitions, parent styles, scores, and matched feeling words.
Expand local matching with optional fuzzy matching of related dictionary terms.
Look up a feeling word or retrieve words associated with a style through free API endpoints.
Retrieve paid style details and image-reference links with source, license, and image-type metadata.
Use optional paid cloud analysis when no feeling words match and cloud access and quota are configured.
limitations: Requires Python 3.8 or later and an initial online dictionary download.
Local analysis uses dictionary matches, not general semantic understanding; fuzzy matching can include opposite meanings.
Offline analysis requires an unexpired cache; lookup and reference-image commands still require network access.
Cloud analysis and image endpoints consume quota; the client retrieves reference-image links and does not generate images.

use_cases.title: Develop concept-art directions
use_cases.description: Translate a scene mood into style candidates, then compare definitions and matched terms before selecting an artistic direction.

use_cases.title: Refine image-generation vocabulary
use_cases.description: Find concrete style names and descriptive terms to include in prompts for a separate image-generation tool.

use_cases.title: Explore brand visual references
use_cases.description: Compare styles for a brand mood and retrieve credited image references after approving paid requests.

prompt_templates.title: Find an initial style direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Find visual-style candidates for this mood: [description]. Use local matching and show style names, definitions, and matched terms. Do not use paid endpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Compare exact and fuzzy matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [description] locally, then compare fuzzy matches. Explain which candidates fit and identify conflicting terms. Do not enable paid cloud analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Build an offline art-direction shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the existing cache offline to analyze [description]. Return five style candidates with matched terms. Report missing or expired cache without accessing the network.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a reference-backed brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [description] locally and compare three styles. Request approval before paid calls. After approval, retrieve references and include image types, credits, and licenses.

output_examples.input: Show an example style direction for a rainy convenience-store scene with cold white light.
output: Definition: A crystalline space with frost-white and very pale blue tones.
Matched concepts: White and cold light.
Actual candidates depend on the dictionary and wording.

output_examples.input: Analyze my mood offline when no dictionary cache exists.
output_examples.output: No dictionary cache is available in offline mode. Download the dictionary while online before retrying.

best_practices: Download the dictionary before offline work and refresh it before its cache lifetime expires.
Compare definitions and matched terms; inspect fuzzy results for opposite meanings.
Approve paid requests explicitly and use a trusted HTTPS endpoint; quota headers currently lack redirect protection.
anti_patterns: Treating ranked style scores as objective artistic judgments or calibrated probabilities.
Assuming fuzzy matches always preserve the original mood.
Using placeholder images as authentic style references or omitting image credits.

faq.question: Which operations are free?
faq.answer: Dictionary downloads, local analysis, word lookup, and style-word lookup are free. Cloud analysis, style details, and image-reference requests consume quota.

faq.question: Can I use the skill offline?
faq.answer: Local analysis works offline with an unexpired dictionary cache. Download or refresh the cache beforehand; remote lookup and reference endpoints are unavailable offline.

faq.question: When does cloud analysis run?
faq.answer: Cloud analysis requires zero matched feeling words, explicit cloud opt-in, a configured quota token, and network access. Paid style and image commands are separate.

faq.question: Does the skill generate images?
faq.answer: No. It returns style vocabulary and can retrieve existing reference-image links with attribution metadata. Image generation requires a separate tool.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide one mood or scene description of up to 500 characters. Chinese and English descriptions are documented; local results depend on dictionary coverage.

faq.question: Does my description leave the device?
faq.answer: Local analysis keeps descriptions on the device after dictionary download. Cloud fallback sends descriptions to the configured API; avoid sensitive text.
